validation.error_message: Use at least 32 characters for state encryption.

state_backend.description: S3 backend connection settings, excluding the state key. Credentials come from AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID/AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY.

secrets.description: Complete manually supplied KV data for dev and prd. Import all existing fields before applying; derived keys and generated credentials are owned by OpenTofu.

fleet_age_keys.description: Per-role age private keys for packages/fleet, keyed ci, web, cache or netboot. Written to secret/fleet/<role>, field age_key, for single-use wrapped enrollment tokens. Complete map: an omitted role is removed. Each key must be distinct.

validation.condition: ${alltrue([for role, key in var.fleet_age_keys : contains(["ci", "web", "cache", "netboot", "devbox"], role) && startswith(key, "AGE-SECRET-KEY-")]) && length(distinct(values(var.fleet_age_keys))) == length(var.fleet_age_keys)}
validation.error_message: fleet_age_keys needs roles ci, web, cache or netboot, AGE-SECRET-KEY- values, and no key shared between roles.
